start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-a-titled-block-of-source-words with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and blocks [{\"source_id\": \"message:one\", \"start\": 7, \"end\": 13, \"title\": \"Launch checklist\"}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the blocks are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-a-titled-block-of-source-words" with store and the blocks to keep. Give start and end together, or neither.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts: every attempt must be kept, repeated or refused as the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the new blocks through those objects and reads each one back; a refused block comes back with the store's own words for why.
